public_exploration_boundary.boundary: Recognizing opposite directed pairs and degree counts does not establish discovery of signed/series reformulations. No public computation/report/call shows an abandoned signed/series target or an inability to express its proof. Internal reasons for not pursuing those candidates are not inferred.

generic_prompt_hypothesis.proposal: Develop promising mathematical candidates by their structural value, then choose a relation matching the argument and consult the relevant proof API as needed. Successful verification alone is not the end of mathematical exploration.
generic_prompt_hypothesis.status: UNTESTED. This pair suggests possible early-candidate stopping, but shows no explicit proof-based retreat and does not isolate a prompt effect.
